articles.title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
articles.snippet: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

articles.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
articles.snippet: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

articles.title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
articles.snippet: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.
